{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Ming-Jun Lai''' is an American [[mathematician]], currently a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Georgia]]. His area of research is  [[Spline (mathematics)|splines]] and their numerical analysis. He has published a text on splines called ''Splines Functions on Triangulations''. He was born in [[Hangzhou]], [[China]].<ref name="website">{{official website|http://www.math.uga.edu/~mjlai/}}</ref>

Lai received a [[B.Sc.]] from [[Hangzhou University]] and a [[Ph.D.]] in [[mathematics]] from the [[Texas A&M University]] in 1989.<ref name=cv>{{cite web|last=Lai|first=Ming-Jun|title=Curriculum vitae|url=https://www.math.uga.edu/sites/default/files/CVs/LaiCV2023.pdf|accessdate=2024-04-11}}</ref>  His dissertation was entitled "On Construction of Bivariate and Trivariate Vertex Splines on Arbitrary Mixed Grid Partitions" and supervised by Charles K. Chui.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|17328}}</ref>
